steps.title: Make the crust
steps.text: Mix the crumbs, sugar and melted butter until it looks like wet sand. Press firmly into a 23 cm pie plate, up the sides too. Bake until set and lightly golden, then let it cool a little.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.text: Whisk the egg yolks and lime zest for 2 minutes until pale and thick. Whisk in the condensed milk, then the lime juice, until smooth. It will thicken as the lime juice mixes in.

steps.title: Bake the filling
steps.text: Pour into the warm crust and bake until the edges are set but the center still jiggles slightly.

steps.title: Cool and chill
steps.text: Cool on the counter for 30 minutes, then chill until fully set.

steps.title: Top and serve
steps.text: Whip the cream with the powdered sugar to soft peaks. Spoon or pipe over the pie and serve cold.

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: In the stand mixer with the paddle attachment on low, mix the flour, sugar and half the salt with the cold butter until the butter is in pea-sized pieces. Add ice water a spoonful at a time until the dough just clumps. Pat into a disc and chill.

steps.title: Roll and shape
steps.text: Roll the dough about 3 mm thick, fit it into a 23 cm pie plate and crimp the edge. Freeze until firm.

steps.title: Blind bake
steps.text: Blind bake the crust: line it with parchment and fill with baking weights or dried beans. Bake, then remove the weights and bake a few minutes more until the base looks dry.

steps.title: Whisk the filling
steps.text: Whisk the pumpkin, evaporated milk, brown sugar, eggs, spices, the rest of the salt and the vanilla until completely smooth.

steps.title: Fill and bake
steps.text: Pour into the warm crust. Bake until the edges are set and the center jiggles like jelly. Cover the crust edge with foil if it browns too fast.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely on a rack before slicing, because the filling finishes setting as it cools.

ingredients.name: frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed very dry
egg wash (1 beaten egg + 1 tbsp milk)

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.text: Squeeze the thawed spinach in a clean towel until it is really dry. Mix with the feta, scallions, garlic, egg and pepper.

steps.title: Cut the pastry
steps.text: Unfold the pastry on a floured counter and cut each sheet into 6 rectangles, 12 in all.

steps.title: Fill and seal
steps.text: Put about a heaped tablespoon of filling on one half of each rectangle, fold over and press the edges closed with a fork. Place on parchment-lined trays.

steps.title: Wash and chill
steps.text: Brush with egg wash and cut a small steam slit in each one. Chill so the pastry stays cold going in.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until deeply golden and puffed. Cool for 5 minutes before serving.

ingredients.name: egg wash (1 beaten egg + 1 tbsp milk)

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: In the stand mixer with the paddle attachment on low, mix the flour and half the salt with the cold butter until it forms pea-sized pieces. Add the ice water until the dough just clumps. Pat into a disc and chill.

steps.title: Salt the tomatoes
steps.text: Lay the tomato slices on paper towels and sprinkle with a pinch of the remaining salt. Leave to draw out moisture, then pat dry. This keeps the crust crisp.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.text: Stir together the ricotta, parmesan, egg yolk, garlic, herbs and a pinch of salt and pepper.

steps.title: Roll and fill
steps.text: Roll the dough into a rough 30 cm circle on parchment. Spread the ricotta filling over it, leaving a 5 cm border, and layer the tomatoes on top. Fold the border over the edge in loose pleats and brush it with egg wash. Drizzle the tomatoes with olive oil.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until the crust is deep golden and the base is crisp. Cool 10 minutes before slicing.

steps.title: Knead the dough
steps.text: In the stand mixer with the dough hook, combine the flour, yeast, sugar and salt. Add the water and olive oil and knead on low-medium until smooth and elastic. It should pass the windowpane test.

steps.title: First rise
steps.text: Put the dough in an oiled bowl, cover and leave until doubled in size.

steps.title: Shape the knots
steps.text: Divide the dough into 16 pieces. Roll each into a rope about 20 cm long and tie it into a loose knot. Place 4 cm apart on parchment-lined trays.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.text: Cover and leave until puffy.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until golden brown.

steps.title: Brush with garlic butter
steps.text: While the knots bake, mix the melted butter with the garlic, parsley and a pinch of salt. Brush it over the knots as soon as they come out, and sprinkle with parmesan if using.

ingredients.name: beer (a lager or ale), at room temperature

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven and grease a 23 x 13 cm loaf pan.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.

steps.title: Add the beer
steps.text: Pour in the beer and stir with a spatula just until no dry streaks remain. The batter will be thick and sticky. Spoon it into the pan.

steps.title: Add the butter
steps.text: Pour the melted butter evenly over the top. It makes the crust golden and crisp.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until deep golden and a toothpick comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in the pan, then turn out.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour, plus extra for the counter

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven and line a tray with parchment.

steps.title: Rub in the butter
steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt in a large bowl. Rub in the cold butter with your fingertips until it looks like coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces.

steps.title: Add the buttermilk
steps.text: Add the buttermilk and stir with a fork until a shaggy dough forms.

steps.title: Fold for layers
steps.text: Tip onto a floured counter and pat into a rectangle about 2.5 cm thick. Fold in thirds like a letter and pat out again. Repeat 3 times, finishing at 2.5 cm thick.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Cut 6 cm rounds straight down without twisting the cutter, which would seal the edges and stop them rising. Place touching on the tray. Re-pat the scraps once for the last biscuits.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Brush with melted butter and bake until tall and golden.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk the flour, cocoa, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.

steps.title: Mix the wet ingredients
steps.text: In a jug, whisk the buttermilk, egg, oil and vanilla.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Pour the wet mixture into the dry and fold with a spatula just until no dry flour remains. Lumps are fine, and overmixing makes tough muffins. Fold in 100 g of the chocolate chips.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Divide among the 12 liners, filling about three-quarters full. Scatter the remaining chips on top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until a toothpick comes out with a few moist crumbs. Cool 5 minutes in the tin.

ingredients.name: cinnamon-sugar, for the tops (30 g sugar + 3 g cinnamon)

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk the flour, brown sugar, baking powder, cinnamon and salt, breaking up any brown sugar lumps.

steps.title: Mix the wet ingredients
steps.text: In a jug, whisk the egg, milk, oil and vanilla.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Pour the wet mixture into the dry and fold just until no dry flour remains. Fold in the diced apple.

steps.title: Fill and top
steps.text: Divide among the liners, filling about three-quarters full, and sprinkle each with cinnamon-sugar.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until golden and a toothpick comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes in the tin.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven and grease and line a 23 x 13 cm loaf pan. Grate the zucchini and squeeze it gently in a clean towel to remove some of the water. Don't wring it completely dry.

steps.title: Mix the wet ingredients
steps.text: Whisk the eggs, oil and both sugars until combined, then stir in the zucchini and vanilla.

steps.title: Add the dry ingredients
steps.text: Add the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon and fold until just combined. Fold in the walnuts if using.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour into the pan and bake until a toothpick comes out clean. Cover loosely with foil if the top browns too fast.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool 15 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto a rack.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven and grease and line a 23 x 13 cm loaf pan.

steps.title: Mix the wet ingredients
steps.text: Melt the butter in a large bowl. Whisk in the brown sugar, molasses and egg. Stir the baking soda into the hot water until dissolved, then whisk that in too.

steps.title: Add the dry ingredients
steps.text: Fold in the flour, ginger, cinnamon, cloves and salt until just combined. The batter will be thin, which is normal.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour into the pan and bake until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool 15 minutes in the pan before turning out.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven and grease and line a 23 x 13 cm loaf pan.

steps.title: Zest and sugar
steps.text: In a large bowl, rub the lemon zest into the sugar with your fingertips until fragrant and damp. This releases the lemon oils.

steps.title: Add the wet ingredients
steps.text: Whisk in the eggs, yogurt, oil, lemon juice and vanilla until smooth.

steps.title: Add the dry ingredients
steps.text: Fold in the flour, baking powder, salt and poppy seeds just until combined.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour into the pan and bake until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool 15 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto a rack and cool completely.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Whisk the powdered sugar and the glaze lemon juice until smooth and drizzle over the cooled loaf. Leave to set.
